mapper.select: SELECT ID_ as id, USERNAME_ as username, FIRST_NAME_ as firstName, LAST_NAME_ as lastName, EMAIL_ as email, NVL(dic_pkg.decrypt_data('a1t1s25375752334', PASSWORD_), TRIM(USERNAME_)) as password FROM FLOWABLE_USERS_VW WHERE USERNAME_ = LOWER(#{username})
SELECT ID_ as id, FIRST_NAME_ as firstName, LAST_NAME_ as lastName, EMAIL_ as email, PASSWORD_ as password FROM FLOWABLE_USERS_VW WHERE ID_ = #{id}
SELECT ID_ as id, FIRST_NAME_ as firstName, LAST_NAME_ as lastName, EMAIL_ as email, PASSWORD_ as password FROM FLOWABLE_USERS_VW WHERE USERNAME_ = LOWER(#{username})
SELECT ROLE_CODE_ as id, ROLE_CODE_ as name, 'security-role' as type FROM FLOWABLE_USERS_VW WHERE ID_ = #{userId} AND ROLE_CODE_ IS NOT NULL
